request.query: product of multiindex binomial coefficients over its finite support equals product over all variables

items.name: finprod_mem_mulSupport
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid M] (f : α → M),
  ∏ᶠ (a : α) (_ : a ∈ Function.mulSupport f), f a = ∏ᶠ (a : α), f a

items.name: tprod_eq_prod'
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [inst : CommMonoid α] [inst_1 : TopologicalSpace α] {f : β → α} {L : SummationFilter β}
  [L.LeAtTop] {s : Finset β}, Function.mulSupport f ⊆ ↑s → ∏'[L] (b : β), f b = ∏ b ∈ s, f b

items.name: finprod_mem_inter_mulSupport
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {M : Type u_5} [inst : CommMonoid M] (f : α → M) (s : Set α),
  ∏ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s ∩ Function.mulSupport f), f i = ∏ᶠ (i : α) (_ : i ∈ s), f i

items.name: Finsupp.multinomial_eq_of_support_subset
items.type: ∀ {α : Type u_1} {f : α →₀ ℕ} {s : Finset α}, f.support ⊆ s → f.multinomial = Nat.multinomial s ⇑f
